title: User login success with valid credentials
description: Verify that the user can successfully log in using valid username and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username and password.
Click the login button.
Verify that the login is successful and dashboard is displayed.

title: User registration success with valid data
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid registration data.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Enter valid registration details.
Submit the registration form.
Verify that the registration completes and user is redirected to the dashboard or login page.

title: Dashboard loads and displays user projects
description: Verify that after login, the dashboard loads and correctly displays the user projects with accessible links.

steps.description: Log in successfully.
Wait for dashboard page to load.
Verify the projects list is displayed and contains valid project items.
Click on a project item.
Verify navigation to the project detail page.

title: Project detail page loads project and scenes with loading indication
description: Verify that the project detail page asynchronously loads both project data and associated scenes with loading spinners or status displayed during fetch.

steps.description: Navigate to a project detail page with valid projectId.
Verify loading spinner or status indicator appears while project and scenes data are being fetched.
Verify project and scenes data loaded successfully and displayed.

title: Error handling when nodeStore.loadSceneNodes API fails
description: Validate that when loading scene nodes fails due to API error, the UI displays appropriate error messaging and allows retry or recovery.

steps.description: Simulate failure of nodeStore.loadSceneNodes API call.
Navigate to scene editor page.
Verify the UI shows a meaningful error message indicating the failure.
Verify retry mechanism or error dismissal is available.

title: URL parameters projectId and sceneId parsed correctly on page load
description: Confirm that the application correctly parses and uses projectId and sceneId from the URL parameters when loading the project and scene pages.

steps.description: Manually construct and load URL with valid projectId and sceneId parameters.
Verify that the corresponding project and scene data are fetched and displayed correctly.

title: Node selection and deselection updates states properly
description: Verify that selecting and deselecting nodes on the scene editor updates the internal node selection state accordingly and triggers relevant events.

steps.description: Open scene editor and select a node by clicking it.
Verify the node appears selected and state reflects selection.
Click the selected node again or elsewhere to deselect.
Verify the node is deselected and state updates accordingly.

title: Keyboard shortcuts Delete and Backspace delete nodes only when input not focused
description: Verify that pressing Delete or Backspace keys deletes selected nodes only if input fields are not focused to prevent accidental deletion during text editing.

steps.description: Select one or more nodes in the scene editor.
Ensure no input field is focused.
Press Delete key.
Verify selected nodes are deleted.
Focus an input field inside scene editor.
Press Delete or Backspace key.
Verify nodes are not deleted.

title: Ctrl+Z undo reverts last node editing action properly
description: Check that pressing Ctrl+Z correctly reverts the last changes made to nodes, integrating with the nodeStore history stack.

steps.description: Modify or delete a node on the scene editor.
Press Ctrl+Z keyboard shortcut.
Verify that the last action is undone and node state is restored appropriately.

title: Auto-layout rearranges nodes correctly without layout corruption
description: Verify that invoking the auto-layout feature recalculates node positions and visually arranges nodes without corrupting graph structure or breaking links.

steps.description: Add multiple nodes to the scene in disorder.
Click the auto-layout button.
Verify nodes are repositioned neatly.
Verify no links or graph connections are lost or corrupted.

title: Real-time collaboration room join establishes socket connection
description: Confirm that when a user opens the scene editor, the collabStore.joinRoom method correctly initiates a socket connection and joins the collaboration room for real-time updates.

steps.description: Open scene editor page with an active project and scene.
Verify socket connection is established and user has joined the collaboration room.

title: Real-time collaboration room leave disconnects socket cleanly
description: Verify that when the scene editor is closed or user leaves the page, collabStore.leaveRoom disconnects the socket properly to avoid zombie connections.

steps.description: Close or navigate away from the scene editor page.
Verify that the socket connection is disconnected properly without residual open connections.

title: Real-time cursor and state updates reflect other user's activity instantly
description: Verify that when multiple users are collaborating, cursor positions and node state changes from other remote users appear instantly and correctly on the current user's scene editor.

steps.description: User A and User B both open the same scene editor.
User A moves cursor or edits nodes.
Verify User B sees User A's cursor movement and node changes in real-time without delay.

title: Timeline clips recompute immediately after confirmedVideos data changes
description: Check that when confirmedVideos data is updated, the timeline clips data recomputes immediately with updated durations and thumbnails.

steps.description: Modify or update confirmedVideos data in timeline store.
Verify timeline clips are recalculated and UI updates to reflect the changes.

title: Timeline totalDuration sums clip durations accurately
description: Verify that the totalDuration of timeline clips sums all clip durations correctly and gracefully handles missing thumbnail or version info without rendering errors.

steps.description: Provide timeline clips with varying durations including some with missing thumbnails or version data.
Verify totalDuration is accurate and no UI errors occur due to missing data.

title: UI elements like auto-layout button maintain position after drag-and-drop
description: Confirm that UI elements such as the auto-layout button retain their placement and do not overlap or move unexpectedly after drag-and-drop node operations on the scene editor canvas.

steps.description: Drag and drop multiple nodes around the scene editor.
Verify that the auto-layout button remains in its correct position and is accessible.

title: Responsive layout adapts correctly on various screen sizes
description: Test that the UI layout including canvas, panels, buttons, and menus adapts fluidly to smaller and larger screen sizes without overlap, distortion, or hidden controls.

steps.description: Resize browser window or simulate multiple device screen sizes.
Verify no overlapping panels or controls.
Verify the canvas and UI scale appropriately and remain fully functional.

title: User profile viewing and editing saves changes successfully
description: Confirm that user can view their profile information, make edits, and save updates successfully, with changes persisting after reload.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile page.
Verify profile fields are displayed correctly.
Edit profile information.
Save changes.
Verify changes are saved and reflected in the profile view.
Refresh or reopen profile page.
Verify updated information persists.

title: Robust asynchronous data loading with Promise.all for project and scenes
description: Validate that project and scenes data are loaded asynchronously using Promise.all and the operations resolve in intended sequence with correct data mapping.

steps.description: Load project detail page for a valid project.
Verify Promise.all resolves successfully for loadProject and loadScenes APIs.
Confirm UI displays data only after both API calls complete.
